visualCharacteristics: Full-width decorative anniversary banner: celebratory heading text (e.g. 'Celebrating 75 Years of Saga') with a large numeral and decorative emblem/marble graphics arranged side-by-side. Centered, stacked on mobile; horizontal row on desktop.
contentPattern: One row with multiple cells: text cell(s) + decorative image cell(s). Image-only cells become image columns.
usage: Decorative brand/anniversary banner spanning the full width.
